caveats.1: The two validator warnings were rdflib and a headless browser missing from that sandbox, not defects in the model.
caveats.2: B7 — the run on the real CIC-IDS2017 folder — was not executed, because the dataset was not reachable from that session. The equivalent ran on a synthetic folder of the same shape.
caveats.3: One failing case, PSI against permutation, turned out to be a wrong test rather than a wrong check; it is documented as a limit in shape-contract.md §3 instead of being quietly removed.
caveats.4: One static verifier, dataset-shaper, returned REVISE on its first pass and SHIP on the second. The first pass counts.

foot.tagline: A neurosymbolic analysis chain for Claude Code. The owl is Athene noctua, the little owl.
hero.eyebrow: a family of Claude Code skills
hero.lede: Nine skills turn a codebase, a database schema, prose or a dataset into one self-contained HTML model that carries its own engines. The language model proposes; SPARQL, SWRL, Prolog and DMN decide. /noctua classifies the sources, drives the right lane stage by stage and verifies each product before proposing the next — it never does a stage's work.

orch.body: The orchestrator, above the grid rather than in it, because it is not a stage. It reads a project, classifies its sources, reads the ledger, and drives the right lane stage by stage by invoking the specialist skills, verifying each product before proposing the next. It never does a stage's work — not a little of it, not the easy part.

sketches.foot: /architect and /improve are built and installed, but Noctua never schedules them on its own initiative: it names them as options when their input exists.
sketches.heading: Four chain skills are still sketches.
sketches.lede: The design contract names them and marks their status as sketch. They are listed here with that word, because a roadmap presented as a feature list is the oldest lie on a project page.
stages.heading: Each skill has one job, stated in its own words.
stages.lede: Eight of the nine ship in this package; every card below is condensed from that skill's own SKILL.md description, with nothing added. /domain-forge covers two rows of the chain map — it forges a model from prose and it refines any model — which is why ten stages are nine skills.
start.heading: Nine folders, a Python environment, one command.
start.s1.b: Copy the package's nine skill folders into your Claude Code skills directory, in place of the v2 ones. effective-java stays as it is — it is blueprint's anchor corpus, an external skill this package does not carry.
start.s2.b: Python 3.10 or later with rdflib, numpy, pandas, scipy and scikit-learn; pyarrow for parquet, statsmodels for time series, geopandas, pyproj and shapely for spatial work; matplotlib for figures; and a headless Chromium or Chrome on PATH or in $CHROME for the symbolic verification and the smoke tests.
start.s3.b: On a first run it creates .claude/noctua-ledger.md and says so, checks the environment and reports which lanes that leaves open, classifies the sources it finds, asks once per lane what the lane is for — offering destinations with what each one does not give you — then proposes the next stage with the exact invocation, and waits.
verify.c1.b: The artifact is one self-contained HTML file with no network dependencies, and the SPARQL, SWRL, Prolog and DMN engines that answer questions about it travel inside it. Open it in a browser five years from now and it still runs.
verify.c2.b: Each chain skill is a pure function over that file: the input is never modified, the output is a strict superset, and stripping a layer returns the predecessor byte for byte — strip(apply(x)) == x. To revert a step you open the previous file.
verify.c3.b: The standalone pandas script the shaper emits is a second implementation of the same recipe. Its outputs have to match the manifest's digests byte for byte, and they do — that is the test, not a promise in a README.
verify.c4.b: validate_model.py checks invariants 1–19, of which 13–16 are the layer-chain invariants that hold the superset property. The orchestrator runs a stage's own check before the lane is allowed to advance; a product that failed never becomes the current artifact.
verify.c5.b: .claude/noctua-ledger.md holds the chain state — sources with their digests, lanes, objectives, history. It is deliberately separate from the forges' .claude/domain-forge-memory.md, which records modelling decisions; Noctua reads that file and never writes to it.
verify.c5.h: State on disk, not in a conversation
verify.heading: The engines decide, and the numbers are published.
verify.lede: A chain of language-model outputs is only worth as much as the checks between its links. These are the checks, and below them the results of the v3 build — including what it did not cover.
